tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search and filter public architecture, engineering and construction tenders across Europe from Pelenoir Tenders of Europe (updated daily). All parameters are optional. Call get_tenders_overview first to see valid countries, disciplines and typologies. Every result links to its pelenoir.com page; the

tools.name: get_tender_detail
tools.description: Full public detail of one tender: scope, Pelenoir assessment, how to take part, contracting authority, procedure, value, CPV codes, the pelenoir.com page and the original notice.

tools.name: get_tenders_overview
tools.description: Counts of tenders per country, the exact discipline and typology values present in the data, the deadline range and the time of the last data update. Use it to choose valid filters for search_tenders.
